podcast.title: Early Opera Prodigy
podcast.body: Born in Communist East Berlin, Nina Hagen was recognized as an opera prodigy by the age of nine. However, she rebelled against this path, preferring to perform songs that were not officially permitted by the Communist regime, leading to complications. "Lena was born in Communist East Berlin and was declared to be an opera prodigy by the time she was nine, but opera wasn't her thing much to the consternation of the authorities."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Move to West Germany and Artistic Evolution
podcast.body: A series of complications stemming from her defiance led Nina Hagen to move to West Germany. There, she continued to pursue the kind of music that had been forbidden in East Germany. Her performances grew increasingly unusual, her costuming became more outrageous, and her distinctive singing style garnered significant attention. "A series of complications found Nina living in West Germany, where she continued to pursue the kind of music that was forbidden at home."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Outrageous Performance Style
podcast.body: After moving to West Germany, Nina Hagen's performances grew increasingly unusual, characterized by her outrageous costuming and distinctive singing style. She became known as a German singer, actress, and performance artist, embracing a multi-faceted artistic identity. "And her performances became more and more unusual. Her costuming became more outrageous. And her singing style got attention for, well, just listen."

podcast.title: Political Defiance and Exile
podcast.body: Nina Hagen's insistence on performing forbidden songs under the Communist regime in East Berlin led to a series of complications that ultimately resulted in her living in West Germany. There, she continued to pursue the unconventional music she had championed, further developing her unique artistic expression. "She insisted on performing songs that were not officially allowed by the Communist regime."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Unusual Performance Style
podcast.body: Nina Hagen, described as a German singer, actress, and performance artist, cultivated a unique and attention-grabbing performance style, marked by outrageous costuming and a distinct singing approach. Her performance of "African reggae" is cited as an example of her quirky artistry. "German singer, actress and performance artist, Nina Hagen, performing African reggae."
